crossRefs.note: for the sins of Jeroboam which he sinned, and with which he made Israel to sin, because of his provocation with which…
They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God. They have provoked me to anger with their vanities. I will…
Don’t turn away to go after vain things which can’t profit or deliver, for they are vain.
They rejected his statutes, and his covenant that he made with their fathers, and his testimonies which he testified to…
Behold, all of their deeds are vanity and nothing. Their molten images are wind and confusion.
For the customs of the peoples are vanity; for one cuts a tree out of the forest, the work of the hands of the workman…
But they are together brutish and foolish, instructed by idols! It is just wood.
They are vanity, a work of delusion. In the time of their visitation they will perish.
Those who regard lying vanities forsake their own mercy.
Because knowing God, they didn’t glorify him as God, and didn’t give thanks, but became vain in their reasoning, and…
Therefore concerning the eating of things sacrificed to idols, we know that no idol is anything in the world, and that…
What am I saying then? That a thing sacrificed to idols is anything, or that an idol is anything?
But I say that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to demons, and not to God, and I don’t desire…

people.name: Baasha
people.line: Third king of Israel who ruled for 24 years.

people.name: Elah
people.line: Son of Baasha, king of Israel

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: for all the sins of Baasha, and the sins of Elah his son, which they sinned, and with which they made Israel to sin, to provoke Yahweh, the God of Israel, to anger with their vanities.
translations.bsb: This happened because of all the sins Baasha and his son Elah had committed and had caused Israel to commit, provoking the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger with their worthless idols.
translations.kjv: For all the sins of Baasha, and the sins of Elah his son, by which they sinned, and by which they made Israel to sin, in provoking the LORD God of Israel to anger with their vanities.
translations.asv: for all the sins of Baasha, and the sins of Elah his son, which they sinned, and wherewith they made Israel to sin, to provoke Jehovah, the God of Israel, to anger with their vanities.
